slots.label: Step 1: Lobby and Passes menu
slots.hint: Capture the lobby with the Passes menu visible. You can highlight where to click in your own screenshot.
slots.alt: Fortnite lobby with the English Passes tab outlined in red
slots.caption: Select Passes in the top navigation, outlined in red in this owner-supplied screenshot. The main navigation is in English; some promotional and mode labels elsewhere in the capture remain in Chinese.
slots.credit: Screenshot supplied by the site owner; Fortnite © Epic Games

slots.label: Step 2: Browse the available passes
slots.hint: Capture the Battle Pass page with the Passes & FN Crew entry visible.
slots.alt: Fortnite Battle Pass overview with the Passes and FN Crew entry at the bottom
slots.caption: The Passes area can open on Battle Pass first. Select Passes & FN Crew near the bottom to browse the other passes. This is the Battle Pass screen, not the Teto Music Pass; its December 4, 2026 end date does not apply to Teto’s pass.
slots.credit: Screenshot supplied by the site owner; Fortnite © Epic Games

slots.label: Step 3: Open the Teto Music Pass
slots.hint: Capture the Teto Music Pass and its Get Music Pass button, or the following price confirmation. Leave out personal and payment details.
slots.alt: English TWINDRILL DIVA Music Pass overview with a Get Music Pass button at the bottom right
slots.caption: Select the Music Pass tile, then choose Get Music Pass at the bottom right to review the standalone offer. The large yellow Join Fortnite Crew button opens a separate subscription route. Its HK$76 monthly display is a regional Crew price, not the V-Bucks pass checkout.
slots.credit: Screenshot supplied by the site owner; Fortnite © Epic Games

slots.label: Step 4: Claim and equip the base Outfit
slots.hint: Capture the Teto reward marked Claimed with Equip available, or the owned Outfit in your Locker.
slots.alt: Fortnite Music Pass screen showing Kasane Teto marked Claimed with an Equip button
slots.caption: The base Kasane Teto Outfit marked Claimed in the Music Pass. The Equip button is available on this reward screen; this image does not show the Locker menu.
slots.credit: Screenshot by Kacee Fay / Destructoid; game by Epic Games

slots.label: Step 5: Unlock the reactive style
slots.hint: Capture the final reactive-style reward or the unlocked style. State in the caption whether it is a preview or an owned reward.
slots.alt: Kasane Teto Reactive On selected as the final reward on Music Pass page three, with the locked-page condition visible
slots.caption: Kasane Teto (Reactive On) is selected at the end of page 3. In this account’s captured state, the page says “Claim 9 more rewards OR earn 20 levels to unlock.” That message describes the page gate; it is not an already-claimed style. Frame from STEALTHY’s showcase at 2:12.
slots.credit: Video frame: STEALTHY; Fortnite © Epic Games / respective rights holders
